reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Colorado
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: For eviction proceedings, does a tenant have to request a stay of execution for an appeal?
*/

% ----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% ----------------------------

jurisdiction(colorado).
focus_year(2021).

case(eviction_case1).
eviction_proceeding(eviction_case1).

party(tenant1).
party(landlord1).

role_in_case(tenant1, eviction_case1, tenant).
role_in_case(landlord1, eviction_case1, landlord).

county_court_judgment_rendered(eviction_case1).

% Tenant is "aggrieved" by the county court judgment and appeals.
feels_aggrieved(tenant1, eviction_case1).
appeal_filed(tenant1, eviction_case1).

% In the statute, the stay occurs "Upon the court's taking such appeal".
% We encode that the court has taken/accepted the appeal.
appeal_taken_by_court(eviction_case1).

% Scenario summary predicate required by the instructions.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(colorado),
    focus_year(2021),
    case(Case),
    Case = eviction_case1,
    eviction_proceeding(Case),
    role_in_case(Tenant, Case, tenant),
    Tenant = tenant1,
    county_court_judgment_rendered(Case),
    feels_aggrieved(Tenant, Case),
    appeal_filed(Tenant, Case),
    appeal_taken_by_court(Case).

% ----------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% ----------------------------

/*
  CO Code  13-40-117 (2021)
  "If either party feels aggrieved by the judgment rendered ... before the county court, he may appeal ..."
*/
statute_co_13_40_117_may_appeal(Party, Case) :-
    party(Party),
    case(Case),
    county_court_judgment_rendered(Case),
    feels_aggrieved(Party, Case).

/*
  CO Code  13-40-117 (2021)
  "Upon the court's taking such appeal, all further proceedings in the case shall be stayed ..."
  Encoded as an automatic stay triggered by the court taking the appeal.
*/
statute_co_13_40_117_stay_upon_appeal_taken(Case) :-
    case(Case),
    appeal_taken_by_court(Case).

/*
  CO Code  13-40-117 (2021)
  Appellee may petition for additional undertaking if they believe serious economic harm may occur.
  (Not necessary to answer the stay-request question, but included to encode the statute's major parts.)
*/
statute_co_13_40_117_appellee_may_petition_additional_undertaking(Appellee, Case) :-
    party(Appellee),
    case(Case),
    appeal_taken_by_court(Case),
    role_in_case(Appellee, Case, appellee),
    believes_serious_economic_harm_during_pendency(Appellee, Case).

/*
  CO Code  13-40-117 (2021)
  "The court shall order such undertaking only after a hearing and upon a finding that..."
*/
statute_co_13_40_117_court_orders_additional_undertaking_only_if(Case) :-
    case(Case),
    additional_undertaking_petitioned(Case),
    hearing_held_on_additional_undertaking(Case),
    finding_substantial_likelihood_serious_economic_harm(Case),
    finding_not_adequately_protected_by_existing_appeal_requirements(Case).

% ----------------------------
% Reasoning helpers
% ----------------------------

% In Colorado under  13-40-117, a stay is automatic once the appeal is taken by the court.
stay_is_automatic_upon_appeal_taken(Case) :-
    statute_co_13_40_117_stay_upon_appeal_taken(Case).

% The question asks whether the tenant must REQUEST a stay of execution for an appeal.
% Under this statute, the stay is automatic; thus a request is not required when the appeal is taken.
tenant_must_request_stay_of_execution_for_appeal(Case) :-
    eviction_proceeding(Case),
    % If the stay is automatic, then no request is needed; so a "must request" only holds when not automatic.
    \+ stay_is_automatic_upon_appeal_taken(Case).

% ----------------------------
% Final answer (must be deterministic: yes or no)
% ----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    case(Case),
    Case = eviction_case1,
    tenant_must_request_stay_of_execution_for_appeal(Case),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ----------------------------
% Main entrypoint + required initialization
% ----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: For eviction proceedings, does a tenant have to request a stay of execution for an appeal?
